# Lone Star Cafe

> Restaurant in San Antonio, Texas. Cowboy steaks, smoked brisket and country fried steak on a patio over the river.

- Address: 237 Losoya St, San Antonio, TX 78205
- Areas: San Antonio, Converse, Schertz, Boerne, New Braunfels
- Offers: Cowboy steaks; Brisket, ribs and BBQ; Burgers and lunch
- Rating: 3.9 from 2759 Google reviews
